statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold while the post-holiday downside path is unresolved.
recommendation: Current Tail is 24%. External Stress is extreme, but the available evidence does not yet verify a persistent no-retracement NQ path.
headline: Upper-WATCH Tail risk ahead of the first post-holiday U.S. cash open
body: The latest independently timestamped U.S. futures update showed Nasdaq-100 futures at 29,513.25, down 0.18%, while VIX and crude were higher. Reuters reported Brent near $99 and the U.S. 10-year yield near 4.80%. More recent granular NQ pullback sequencing was not independently verified by cutoff, limiting Tail to WATCH rather than a block.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hour slots, published ChatGPT Tail ranged from 17% to 27% while Stress remained at 100%. The path moved from event/whipsaw into mixed conditions, briefly trend-up, then trend-down by 08:00 UTC as downside persistence strengthened.
outlookSummary: The principal danger window is the first post-holiday U.S. cash-open sequence. Forecast Tail peaks conditionally at 33% in the 14:00 UTC hour only if an unrepaired opening impulse holds near an extreme and repeatedly extends after failed pullbacks; meaningful gap repair or two-sided discovery returns Tail below the block threshold.
